title: Opossum Wraps
description: One row per working day, added by the 4:30 Wrap flow (weekdays 16:30 Pacific) alongside its Teams message and tomorrow.json. The Hub's Day screen reads it. Rows older than 1 year (by Date) are deleted by the monthly cleanup flow.
sourceFiles: Microsoft To Do (Business) tasks read by the 4:30 Wrap flow
rowKey: Date (unique, date only). The 4:30 Wrap looks the day up with $filter=Date eq '<yyyy-MM-dd>' and patches the row if a re-run finds one, otherwise creates it.
retention: 1 year by Date. The Alerts cleanup flow (monthly) deletes rows with Date lt addDays(today, -365).

columns.source: the wrapped day as text, convertFromUtc(utcNow(), 'Pacific Standard Time', 'yyyy-MM-dd') (display only)
the day being wrapped: convertFromUtc(utcNow(), 'Pacific Standard Time', 'yyyy-MM-dd') at the 4:30 run. Not tomorrow.json forDate (that is the next working day; see ForDate).
4:30 Wrap: count of To Do tasks with status 'completed' whose completedDateTime falls on today's Pacific date (not in any app file)
4:30 Wrap: count of To Do tasks whose status is not 'completed' (the same Filter array that feeds tomorrow.json items, before take(…, 10))
4:30 Wrap: open To Do tasks whose dueDateTime date is before today's Pacific date
4:30 Wrap: open To Do tasks with status 'waitingOnOthers'
tomorrow.json forDate (next working day; Friday -> Monday). Added beyond the blueprint.
length(tomorrow.json items) (0–10). Added beyond the blueprint.
tomorrow.json items: one line per item, title (plus ' (due yyyy-MM-dd)' when due is set), joined with a line break; at most 10 items × 200 characters
the text of the Teams wrap message the 4:30 Wrap posted (plain text, take(…, 63000))

views.title: All Items
views.note: Columns are added to the default view by CreateFieldAsXml option 16; ForDate and Tomorrow are created without it. Sorting newest first is done in the Hub.

body.Title: Opossum Wraps
body.Description: OG Opossum Command Central: one 4:30 wrap per working day. Kept 1 year.
